title: ReSim: Reliable World Simulation for Autonomous Driving

layout.note: Three full-width bands lettered a, b, c and separated by dashed horizontal rules: three tinted data cards in a row, a two-lane comparison with databases and model boxes on the left, frame strips in the middle and a Video2Reward funnel and trophy at the right, and three application cards with small bar charts or icon chains.

lesson: Tie data, method and applications together with colour: give each data source a colour and numeral on its card, carry it onto the database icons that feed the model, and draw the baseline as a grey lane above the coloured proposed lane with the same slots; end with small icon-story cards for the downstream uses.
